timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,518–1,520 KRW per USD

WHY: The won is currently strengthening (rates dropping from 1,560s toward 1,512–1,520 range), meaning you need fewer won to buy your $2,000. News indicates the rate has fallen ~23 won over recent days and stabilized below 1,520, with government and central bank intervention supporting won strength and reduced volatility expected around 1,510 as geopolitical tensions ease.

TIP: Lock in your $2,000 conversion now while the won is strong; avoid waiting for further weakness, as the government is actively defending this level and future depreciation risk remains given external pressures.
